categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Baose Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of special material non-standard pressure vessel equipment and related welded pipelines and fittings made from titanium, nickel, zirconium, tantalum, copper, high-grade stainless steel, and metal composites. Its products serve industries requiring corrosion resistance, high pressure, and high temperature capabilities, including chemical, energy, metallurgy, power, environmental protection, marine engineering, and shipbuilding sectors. The company also has a strategic business segment in ship and marine engineering equipment manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced materials such as titanium alloys, nickel-based alloys, zirconium, and composite materials, integrating them with sophisticated manufacturing technologies including CAD/CAM design, CNC machining, automated welding (including robotic and intelligent welding systems), heat treatment, non-destructive testing, and digitalized production management. It holds certifications like ASME U and U2 stamps and employs proprietary technologies in large-scale pressure vessel design, welding, and assembly, supported by a strong R&D framework and collaborations with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large domestic and international chemical, petrochemical, energy, and new energy enterprises, as well as shipbuilding and marine engineering companies. The company serves major projects in PTA, PDH, MMA, acetic acid, ABS resin, fine chemicals, coal chemical, photovoltaic polysilicon, and new energy battery materials. It has established long-term partnerships with leading engineering firms, design institutes, and multinational corporations across China, the Americas, Europe, and Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong presence in the Yangtze River Delta industrial cluster, covering major domestic regions including East China, Northwest China, and others. It also exports products to international markets such as the United States, Canada, Germany, Australia, Spain, Indonesia, Chile, and the Middle East. Its strategic location near major transportation hubs facilitates efficient domestic and international logistics.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Baose operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, installation, and servicing of specialized pressure vessels and related equipment. It procures raw materials like titanium, zirconium, and nickel alloys from upstream suppliers and delivers customized equipment solutions directly to end-users in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in advanced materials application, intelligent manufacturing, and digital transformation. Key R&D directions include parameterized 3D design, intelligent welding technologies, new inspection and testing methods, and development of high-performance equipment for emerging sectors like deep-sea engineering and new energy. It actively pursues collaborations with academic institutions and participates in national key research projects to enhance its technological leadership and product competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized non-standard pressure vessel equipment and related pipeline products. The company operates on an order-based production model, with sales contracts typically involving milestone payments including advance payments, progress payments, delivery payments, and warranty deposits. It also provides installation, after-sales services, and technical consulting as part of its integrated solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanjing Baose is a leading domestic player in the high-end special material non-standard pressure vessel manufacturing industry, recognized as a pioneer and technology leader. It holds a top-tier market position with a comprehensive product portfolio and strong brand reputation. Competitors include other large state-owned and private enterprises in China, as well as foreign companies with advanced technologies. The company differentiates itself through its extensive R&D capabilities, advanced manufacturing equipment, and strategic focus on emerging sectors like marine engineering and new energy.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported stable revenue of approximately RMB 1.7 billion in 2024, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 68.4 million, reflecting a moderate growth compared to prior years. It maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 2.4 billion and has shown significant improvement in operating cash flow. The company invests around 4.2% of its revenue in R&D, supporting sustained innovation and growth. Despite market challenges, it continues to expand its order book and enhance operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing Baose offers highly customized, technologically advanced pressure vessel solutions that meet stringent requirements for corrosion resistance, high pressure, and temperature endurance. Its products are critical to core industrial processes in chemical, energy, and marine sectors, providing reliability and performance that support customers' operational stability and efficiency. The company’s integration of cutting-edge materials science, intelligent manufacturing, and comprehensive service capabilities creates a strong competitive edge and positions it as a trusted partner for high-end equipment needs.
